correctness.rationale: The group Fourier basis diagonalizes the exact transition matrix. The two-root sum argument forces every positive-bias collision to a conjugate pair, strict cosine monotonicity excludes multiple simultaneous collisions, and the cyclic-difference pairing proves the signed product formula. The integer-algebraicity argument gives the rational special case. The reconstructed proof is all-n; exact rational determinant tests n=2..12 and independent product tests support, but do not replace it.
